equivalence.retaken: 2026-09-04 11:15 UTC+1, after the fold, both sides served in turn on their own ports; the run's own census was shed mid-body at zoom 0 with `layers: "all"`

shed_in_the_run.note: the run's own census was shed mid-body on the zoom-0 whole-extent request with `layers: "all"` — 1,001,193 artifacts against a stream deadline, the post-flush artifact-frames finding at this scale and not a count difference. Retaken on the same folded deployment after the fold, both sides served in turn, and it went through.

notes: Both batteries are reduced runs and the parameters are in each: view `bioclip`, zooms 0/6/12, decile 9 only, one cell per decile, 40 hot samples and 6 cold. A cold sample at 2.33e8 rows against a 39.97 GB bundle is a fresh fragment build plus a re-fault, so cold and hot are two budgets rather than one.

The 50% target cannot be hit on this rung and the reason is the compartment's shape: iNaturalist.org alone is 57.9% of the corpus, so the greedy composition under a 50% budget takes every other publisher (473 terms) and reaches 42.14%. The other five targets are exact.

The 24 GiB cap held: oom 0, oom_kill 0, memory.peak exactly at the cap with 19,942 reclaim-at-max events over the battery, zero request failures, and 160 of 160 count-bearing responses identical to the uncapped run on a separate drive. Uncapped memory.peak is 27.4 GB. The server's anonymous floor before any request is 15.96 GB, built at open in 87.7 s over 1,001,193 artifacts across two views.

The vectors were never staged. 346 GB of float16 against 217 GB free, so the layout is fitted on 2,500,000 rows staged in 33.9 min at 25.0 MB/s and every row is placed in one 2 h 55 m pass off the share at 20,977 rows/s. The pass checkpoints per row group and retries a read four times; three transient retries succeeded and one row group is corrupt at the source (train-00035-of-00666.parquet group 4, ZSTD decompression failed on its emb column, off the share and off a byte copy on local disk). Those 50,000 rows (0.021%) carry the layout's centroid rather than a position of their own.

The build converges and the stage that binds is filter_postings at 2,125 s of 4,233 - an indexed 474-key publisher column plus two indexed name columns over 2.33e8 rows. text_index is 32 s, against rung 4's non-convergence on 118.9 GB of abstracts. uuid alone is 8.0 GB of the 39.97 GB bundle.

Ingest: the hold-out entered the anchor view alone. `bioclip` holds all 233,055,986 rows after the fold and `geo` holds 88,455,838 - the base's own - because the driver's wire batch carries one row space. A rung with several row spaces over one entity space therefore measures the write path on one of them, and a geo-side equivalence census would differ by construction.

Neither enumerated layer is published at this cell. clusters/kmeans is DECLINED at 233,118,470 member rows (the driver holds a layer's whole membership in memory to address it per artifact) and taxonomy/tree is not in the driver's layer roster at all - its member file is list-keyed, which the publication path does not take. So both are declared and empty on the folded deployment and every layers difference below is that, by design. publishers/source needs no publication - its membership is the indexed column - and it reproduces exactly at five of the six principals.

2,142,399 rows are visible on the all-in bundle and not on the folded one, and the cause is the DRIVER'S WIRE ENCODING rather than the write path. `ingest_cycle.encode_batch` writes the passthrough plugin's `access` as a comma-separated descriptor list; 70 of the 474 publisher names contain a comma, so on the wire each splits into fragments and every fragment not already a term is minted - 617 terms after the fold against the declaration's 475. Measured on the folded deployment: 230,913,587 visible under the 474 declared terms, 233,055,986 under those plus the 148 wire fragments. Where a fragment IS a declared key the rows land in that compartment instead, which is why the 25% principal sees 73,212 rows MORE on the folded deployment: `Natural History Museum, Vienna` splits to `Natural History Museum`. Nothing is lost - verify --deep on the folded bundle counts 321,511,824 rows over two views, entity_id_high_water 233,055,986 and 233,055,986 external-id bindings.

The run's own equivalence census was shed mid-body (ChunkedEncodingError) on the zoom-0 whole-extent request with layers: "all" - 1,001,193 artifacts against a stream deadline, which is the post-flush artifact-frames finding at this scale and not a count difference. It was retaken once after the fold on the same folded deployment with both sides served in turn, and it went through; the equivalence block here is that measurement.

The flush figures are the driver's timeouts rather than the write path's cost: flushes did not move within 900 s and the visibility poll did not reach its expected count within 902 s, because the count it waited for was the all-in total and the wire encoding above put 2,142,399 rows in compartments the polling principal did not hold. The fold itself completed - the server's own last_secs is 1,313 s at 28.9 GB.
